task.description:
A prior WF-02 run (WF02-iss501-504-epic5-20260612) implemented executeSptCutover() in src/admin/tenant_migration.zig and wrote tests/specs/ISS-502.md, but the referenced integration test file was never created and that run's test-designer/test-runner handoffs were left with result=null. Complete the missing test step now.

Write tests/integration/iss502_spt_cutover_test.zig covering the 4 test cases already documented in tests/specs/ISS-502.md:
TC-ISS502-01: cutover copies all rows and flips storage_mode to SCHEMA (already_migrated=false, row counts match).
TC-ISS502-02: cutover is idempotent — re-run on an already-SCHEMA tenant returns already_migrated=true, copies nothing, no error.
TC-ISS502-03: failure rolls back leaving tenant in LEGACY_RLS (inject a PK conflict in the tenant schema before calling executeSptCutover; expect CopyFailed and storage_mode still LEGACY_RLS after).
TC-ISS502-04: row count mismatch is detected and reported (RowCountMismatch).

Update tests/specs/ISS-502.md if the actual test file name differs from what's currently written there (it currently says tests/integration/test_iss502_spt_cutover.zig, but the executeSptCutover implementation and this handoff use tests/integration/iss502_spt_cutover_test.zig — align the doc to match the real file name).

Use real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL, per-test UUIDs for tenant fixtures, no mocks, no error.SkipZigTest on any of the 4 cases. Seed a tenant row, a tenant schema with the SPT_BUSINESS_TABLES subset needed for the test, and representative rows in at least 2-3 business tables (e.g. process_definitions, events, tasks) — the full 22-table list in tenant_migration.zig does not need every table populated, but every table in SPT_BUSINESS_TABLES must exist as an empty table in both public and the tenant schema so the copy loop does not fail on a missing relation.
acceptance_criteria: tests/integration/iss502_spt_cutover_test.zig exists and is runnable via zig build test
All 4 test cases from tests/specs/ISS-502.md are implemented
Real PostgreSQL only, per-test UUIDs, no mocks, no SkipZigTest
tests/specs/ISS-502.md file name reference matches the actual test file

result.summary:
Created tests/integration/iss502_spt_cutover_test.zig implementing all 4 documented test cases (TC-ISS502-01..04) against the real executeSptCutover() contract, using per-test random UUID tenant fixtures, hand-created column-matching SPT_BUSINESS_TABLES fixtures in both public and the tenant schema (avoiding dependence on the full production migration set, which would create incompatible richer-shaped tables with FKs/RLS/triggers out of scope for this unit), and defer-based cleanup on every path. Registered the file in build.zig (dedicated 'test-integration-iss502' step plus inclusion in the main 'test-integration' aggregate step) and in tests/integration/main_test.zig, following the exact pattern used by iss107_tenant_storage_mode_test.zig. Updated tests/specs/ISS-502.md's stale 'Test files' reference from test_iss502_spt_cutover.zig to the real filename iss502_spt_cutover_test.zig.

While verifying the test, found and fixed two compile/bootstrap blockers under Unblock-Everything: (1) src/admin/tenant_migration.zig line ~488-494 had `catch |err| { _ = err; ... }` in executeSptCutover()'s copy loop, which Zig 0.16 rejects as 'error set is discarded' once the function actually has a real caller (it previously had none, so this was latent) — fixed by switching to a bare `catch { ... }`. (2) migrations/GBL-082_fix_audit_chain_resource_id_text.sql's CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bpm_audit_resource_info was missing the DROP FUNCTION the migration's own comment says is required when the OUT-parameter return shape changes (uuid -> text); without it, Postgres raises 42P13 on any pre-existing/stale test DB, blocking every fresh bootstrap. Both fixes are committed alongside the test.

VERIFIED: `zig build` (full project) exits 0. `zig build test-integration-iss502` COMPILES CLEANLY (confirmed by iterating from a hard compile error to a clean build) — this is proof the test is syntactically and type-correct against the real executeSptCutover()/Pool/Conn API surface, not fabricated.

NOT VERIFIED end-to-end (BLOCKER, pre-existing, out of ISS-502 scope): running the 4 tests to a pass/fail verdict against the real BPM_TEST_DB_URL database is blocked by a suite-wide migration-bootstrap defect unrelated to ISS-502. Confirmed independently on a fully fresh bpm_test database (DROP DATABASE + CREATE DATABASE, not just data-truncation) that migrations/GBL-084_rls_removal.sql's pre-flight check ('all tenants must be SCHEMA before RLS removal') fails on a virgin DB: migration 031_adp04b_tenant_realm_binding.sql seeds the default tenant (00000000-...) which defaults to storage_mode='LEGACY_RLS' (added later by 086_iss107_tenant_storage_mode.sql), and nothing in the migration sequence between 031 and GBL-084 ever promotes it to SCHEMA on a from-scratch database — only a prior provisionTenantSchema() call (accumulated from previous, non-fresh test runs) does that. This is NOT a GBL-082-style copy/paste omission; GBL-084 is genuinely missing the migration_window_active guard that its sibling GBL-073 has. Reproduced independently and confirmed pre-existing (unrelated to any of my changes) by running the already-committed, unrelated `zig build test-integration-tm` target against the same fresh DB: it also fails immediately with 'relation "public.tenant" does not exist', 12/14 tests failing. This proves the entire integration-test suite in this codebase has never been validated against a truly fresh database — every integration test target implicitly depends on a long-lived, previously-migrated db_test container accumulating state across runs. The shared db_test container available in this session had accumulated inconsistent partial-migration state from unrelated prior branches/sessions (confirmed via docker exec: GBL-073 applied, GBL-084 not applied, a stale bpm_audit_resource_info signature, a duplicate index in tenant_default.047_repository_form_schemas), and a full DROP/CREATE reset surfaces the GBL-084 pre-flight gap instead. I did not attempt to redesign GBL-084's RLS-removal safety gate myself — this is a production-safety migration whose pre-flight logic is intentionally strict (ISS-503), and changing it is a BACKEND-DEV/CODE-DESIGNER design decision, not a TEST-DESIGNER call.

Did not fabricate a PASS. Marking PARTIAL: the test artifact is complete, correct, and compiles; full pass/fail execution requires either (a) a properly-bootstrapped db_test instance with accumulated migration state (as TEST-RUNNER's normal environment should already have, since ORCH's standard pre-check runs docker-compose up on the existing persistent db_test volume rather than a fresh DROP/CREATE), or (b) a BACKEND-DEV fix to GBL-084's pre-flight gate for fresh-database bootstraps.

issues.description: migrations/GBL-084_rls_removal.sql's ISS-503 pre-flight check ('all tenants must be storage_mode=SCHEMA before RLS removal') fails unconditionally on any freshly-bootstrapped database, because migration 031_adp04b_tenant_realm_binding.sql seeds the default tenant (id=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) which defaults to storage_mode='LEGACY_RLS' (column added later by 086_iss107_tenant_storage_mode.sql), and no migration between 031 and GBL-084 promotes it to SCHEMA on a from-scratch database. Unlike its sibling GBL-073_tnt01_drop_legacy_public_business_tables.sql, GBL-084 has no migration_window_active guard to skip the check during bootstrap/test environments. Reproduced on a fully reset (DROP DATABASE + CREATE DATABASE) bpm_test, and independently confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to ISS-502 by running the already-merged zig build test-integration-tm target against the same fresh DB (12/14 tests fail with 'relation "public.tenant" does not exist'). This blocks any fresh integration-test bootstrap, not just ISS-502's. Recommend routing to BACKEND-DEV: either add a migration_window_active guard to GBL-084 matching GBL-073's pattern, or have an early migration promote the seeded default tenant to SCHEMA once schema-per-tenant provisioning is available, or document that db_test must never be bootstrapped from empty and ship a seed/fixture migration for CI.

migrations/GBL-082_fix_audit_chain_resource_id_text.sql's CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bpm_audit_resource_info changes the OUT resource_id parameter type from uuid to text but was missing the DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS the migration's own comment says is required for that kind of change (Postgres 42P13). Fixed as part of this handoff (DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS bpm_audit_resource_info(TEXT, JSONB, JSONB); added immediately before the CREATE OR REPLACE). Already committed; no further action needed unless a differently-shaped stale signature is discovered elsewhere.

src/admin/tenant_migration.zig's executeSptCutover() had a latent compile defect (catch |err| { _ = err; ... } triggers Zig 0.16's 'error set is discarded' once the function has a real caller) that was invisible until this test file became its first caller. Fixed as part of this handoff. No behavior change — the discarded err was never used.

During this session, a concurrent process/session repeatedly checked out other branches (feature/registry-consolidation) in this same working directory while work was in progress, auto-stashing and in one case apparently dropping in-progress edits (build.zig, tests/integration/main_test.zig, the new test file, and this very handoff file/handoffs/registry.json were all wiped mid-task and had to be recreated). All ISS-502 work was recovered/redone and is safely committed at 5ce4ee7 on feature/WF02-iss502-continuation-20260730 and pushed to origin. Flagging for ORCH awareness — concurrent agent sessions sharing one working directory without worktree isolation risks silent work loss.
